{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) to counteract overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows persistent downward drift (e.g., 3+ consecutive days below 65.00).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high peaks (last 5 days) when sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50 or above) to avoid underreacting to momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 15-20% unless sentiment strongly supports continuation.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is >10% higher than forecast 2-3 days prior, adjust next forecast upward by 5-8% to account for delayed reaction.",
    "Avoid overshoot after spikes: if model forecast exceeds true outcome by >15% in a single day, reduce next forecast by 10-15% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00), use 30-day historical mean as baseline, but adjust downward if true outcome has trended below 68.00 for 5+ days."
  ]
}
